explication: Mastodon is a federated social-network server. Users publish and interact through its web interface or OAuth2 REST API; ActivityPub enables cross-server communication, while feeds and streaming deliver timeline updates. The graph preserves documented product capabilities and sampled runtime components. Some connections are documented at product level rather than confirmed in unsampled controller or service code, so those edges cite the README; implementation detail is limited to the excerpts provided.
